findings: Clang14 emits no measured Ir/Dr/Dw change on the real panels. Both GCC variants keep identical runtime objects and binary.
Clang18 replaces both PUSH opcode memory comparisons with register comparisons, but the surrounding iterator adds stack traffic and other instructions.

The SSL32 format and detail traces each add 1,028,550 simulated instructions, with 364,132 extra stack writes and 364,132 extra stack reads. Total data reads still fall 64,152; considering only the removed comparisons would miss the overall cost.
causal_limit: The observed lowering is consistent with extending first-byte liveness changing register allocation across the iterator. No particular LLVM pass is identified. Simulated instruction cost is diagnostic, not native throughput.
decision: Reject this source expression before native timing; keep the R1466 comparison source as the earlier prototype, which is itself not publication-qualified.
